title: 第一卷 第54章 织天剑宗陈果儿第一卷 第54章 织天剑宗陈果儿
lines: 刚入水的秦绝，就听到湖面上方，传来愤怒的叫骂声。
他整个人也是懵的。
他怎么知道，这荒山野湖里，还有其他人啊。
而且，还是个敢露天洗澡的女人。
噗！
秦绝双脚踩水，脑袋露出水面。
正见一个白光玉背飞落湖岸，飞速揪起地上堆放的几件衣物，便窜入了山林之中，消失不见。
“听她这口气，还会折回来杀我啊，我要不要趁着她还没穿好衣服，过去打她一个措手不及呢？”秦绝唇角一扬，挂起一抹坏笑。
秦绝抬手一抹脸庞，顿时抹了一手粘稠的黑污下来。
“虽然去凡铸灵之后，身体变得极为轻松与舒坦，但这排出来的杂质，也是真够恶心的。”
秦绝嫌弃的将脏手在水里摆了摆，而后再次沉入水中，大力搓洗起来。
一股股黑水如泼墨般在湖中散开，这恶心的味道，却是引来了不少鱼群疯狂吸食。
“这些鱼，莫不是把我当成了一大团发酵窝料了吧？”秦绝有些哭笑不得。
他蓦然弹指，一道金线如丝，破水穿行而去，噗嗤一声，便将一条二十多斤的大青鱼鱼头击穿，大青鱼身体一僵，朝着水底缓沉。
水箭残势，依旧穿行水中，击穿了数条个体略小一些的鱼身，一股血腥气，随之漫开，吓得其他鱼群，顷刻惊散开去。
“这灵力，果然霸道，只是一丝，便如钢针般强硬凌厉！”秦绝心头暗笑，挥手朝着坠落的大青鱼一抓，一股强大的扯动之力，瞬息将大青鱼扯向他来，收入了储物戒中。
数日不吃不喝，他早已饥肠辘辘，稍后正好拿这大青鱼饱餐一顿。
“淫贼，出来受死！”
湖岸方向，传来怒喝之声。
秦绝也搓洗的差不多了，但身上的衣服早已脏得不能穿了，直接灵力一震，将一身衣物，尽数震碎开去。
他浮出脑袋，朝着湖岸上看了一眼。
一个身着白裙，长发湿漉漉的女人，手里持握一剑，正怒指向湖中的他。
这女人肌肤白如雪，生得倾城绝色，就是一张俏脸上，满覆寒霜，眼中杀气浓烈！
“果真是个淫贼！还不上来受死！”女子看到冒头的秦绝，顿时咬牙切齿起来。
她都多希望刚才噗通入水的，是一头大野猪啊……
没想到，还真是个人！
秦绝淡笑道：“我现在可是光溜的，你确定让我就这么上去？”
女子先是一愣，随即猛然大怒，满面涨红道：“你竟敢光着身子下水！如此看来，你果真是想对我行不轨之事了！那你就更是该死了！”
秦绝淡笑道：“你想多了，我来的时候，并不知道有人在水里。要不是你喊得那一嗓子，我还以为是自己的下水动静太大，惊起了一条大白链呢。”
“大白链？”女子脸色一黑，这男子，竟将她比作是一条大白链？
不对！
这小子为什么说是大白链，而不是大花鲢，或者是大黑鱼……
难不成，他看到了自己白净无暇的身子？
“该死的淫贼！我要杀了你！”女子气得右臂发抖，凶吼一声中，蓦然剑尖一震，一股剑气直冲而出，宛如一道白虹，爆射向秦绝的脑袋。
秦绝眉头微挑。
剑气成虹，他倒是没想到，这女人看着年纪也不大，竟是个大宗师。
轰！
秦绝拍掌而出，激起一层浪花，化作一道水墙，轰然撞向剑气。
轰然间，浪花崩溅，形成一片水雾。
“人呢？”
水雾溅落后，女子眼眸一惊。
嗡！
就在女子惊疑时，一丝凉气，豁然贴近了女子的脖子。
content_en:
As soon as Qin Jue entered the water, he heard angry shouts and curses coming from above the lake.
He was also completely confused.
How did he know that there were other people in this deserted mountain and lake?
Moreover, she is a woman who dares to bathe in the open air.
puff!
Qin Jue stepped on the water with his feet and his head was above the water.
Just then I saw a white jade flying down the lake shore, quickly picked up a few pieces of clothing piled on the ground, and then ran into the forest and disappeared.
"Listening to her tone, she will come back to kill me. How about I go over and catch her off guard before she gets dressed?" Qin Jue raised the corners of his lips and put on a wicked smile.
Qin Jue raised his hand and wiped his face, and immediately wiped away the sticky black dirt on his hand.
"Although my body has become extremely relaxed and comfortable after removing the Mortal Casting Spirit, the impurities discharged are really disgusting."
Qin Jue waved his dirty hands in the water in disgust, then sank into the water again and started scrubbing vigorously.
Streams of black water spread out in the lake like splashing ink, but the disgusting smell attracted many fish to suck in it crazily.
"These fish, do they think I'm a big ball of fermented nest material?" Qin Jue was dumbfounded.
He suddenly flicked his fingers, and a golden thread, like silk, broke through the water and went away. With a pop, it penetrated the head of a big herring weighing more than 20 kilograms. The big herring's body stiffened and slowly sank toward the bottom of the water.
The remnant water arrow still traveled through the water, piercing the bodies of several slightly smaller fish. A bloody smell spread out, frightening other fish schools and they dispersed in an instant.
"This spiritual power is indeed overbearing. Just a trace of it is as strong and sharp as a steel needle!" Qin Jue smiled secretly in his heart, waved his hand and grabbed the falling big herring. A powerful pulling force instantly pulled the big herring towards him and put it into the storage ring.
After not eating or drinking for several days, he was already hungry, and later he just had a feast on the big herring.
"Thieves, come out and die!"
From the direction of the lake shore, there was the sound of angry shouting.
Qin Jue had almost finished washing, but the clothes on his body were already so dirty that he couldn't wear them anymore. His spiritual power shook and all the clothes were shattered into pieces.
He raised his head and glanced towards the lake shore.
A woman in a white dress with long wet hair held a sword in her hand and pointed angrily at him in the lake.
This woman's skin is as white as snow, and she is stunningly beautiful. She has a pretty face covered with frost, and her eyes are filled with murderous intent!
"He is really a thief! Why don't you come here and die!" The woman gritted her teeth immediately when she saw Qin Jue coming forward.
She wished that the thing that had just plopped into the water was a big wild boar...
Unexpectedly, he is actually a human being!
Qin Jue smiled lightly and said, "I'm naked now, are you sure you want me to go up like this?"
The woman was stunned for a moment, then suddenly became furious, her face flushed and she said, "How dare you go into the water naked! It seems like you really want to do something wrong to me! Then you deserve to die!"
Qin Jue smiled lightly and said, "You are overthinking. When I came, I didn't know anyone was in the water. If you hadn't shouted so loudly, I would have thought that I made too much noise when I went into the water, and a big white chain was stirred up."
"Big white chain?" The woman's face darkened. This man actually compared her to a big white chain?
wrong!
Why did this guy say it was a big white chain instead of a big silver carp or a big black fish...
Could it be that he saw his flawless body?
"Damn you thief! I'm going to kill you!" The woman's right arm trembled with anger, and with a fierce roar, the tip of the sword suddenly shook, and a sword energy rushed out, like a white rainbow, and shot towards Qin Jue's head.
Qin Jue raised his eyebrows slightly.
The sword energy became a rainbow, but he didn't expect that this woman, who looked young, was actually a great master.
boom!
Qin Jue clapped his hands and came out, stirring up a layer of waves and turning into a wall of water, crashing into the sword energy.
Suddenly, the waves crashed and splashed, forming a mist.
"Where are the people?"
After the water mist splashed, the woman's eyes were startled.
Buzz!
Just when the woman was surprised, a ray of cold air suddenly came close to the woman's neck.
